tasks.name: Book the display company
tasks.notes: Same company as last year; display starts at 19:00 and lasts twenty minutes.

tasks.name: Stewarding plan for the riverside park
tasks.notes: Twenty volunteer stewards, two first aiders and a lost children point by the bandstand.

tasks.name: Hire temporary toilets and lighting towers
tasks.notes: Four toilets and three lighting towers, delivered to the parks yard the day before.

tasks.name: Publicise the display
tasks.notes: Posters in the library and the market square, plus a post on the council pages.

tasks.name: Quarterly inspection, Saxon Rise playground
tasks.notes: Check the zip wire cable, the swing chains and the safety surfacing by the slide.

tasks.name: Replace the cracked springer at Saxon Rise
tasks.notes: Riverside Play Equipment have a matching springer in stock; fitting takes half a day.

tasks.name: Repaint the riverside park railings
tasks.notes: Green gloss, after the leaves are cleared. Two days with the grounds team.

tasks.name: Agree the footpath gritting routes
tasks.notes: Main paths in the riverside park and the market square first; the cemetery paths second.

tasks.name: Service the leaf blowers and the mower fleet
tasks.notes: Blowers before leaf fall, mowers after the last cut; Mill Row Plant Hire to quote.

tasks.name: Order grit for the parks yard
tasks.notes: Twenty tonnes, delivered loose to the covered bay at the parks yard.
